about_the_game:
Welcome to the Grim Hollow Demo – a sneak peek into the immersive open-world survival horror experience where the undead rule the land and survival is anything but guaranteed.

This demo features a closed-off section of the full map, designed specifically for single-player gameplay. You'll undertake a focused mini-mission that showcases the core mechanics of the game, giving you a hands-on feel for combat, exploration, crafting, and survival systems.

Please Note:

  • The multiplayer option in the demo is functional, but currently limited to a prototype map. This is not a full open-world experience and does not reflect the scale or depth of the final version.

  • Many systems—such as AI behavior, quest variety, faction dynamics, AI survivors, zombie types, and equipment—are limited in this demo version and will be fully expanded upon in the complete game.

Key Features (Full Game Preview):

Closed off/limited in demo-- Expansive Open World: Traverse a variety of biomes, from dense jungles and eerie swamps to abandoned urban ruins, each offering unique threats and hidden stories.

Survival Mechanics: Scavenge for food and water, monitor your vitals, and endure the harsh realities of a collapsing world.

Crafting System: Forge tools, weapons, and upgrades from salvaged materials. Customize your loadout to suit your survival strategy.

Village Building: Establish and upgrade your safe zone. Defend it, expand it, and use it as a base to reclaim the world around you.

Only one zombie type on demo--Intelligent AI Enemies: Battle different zombie archetypes and human factions, each with unique behaviors, strengths, and tactics.

Quests and Narrative: Uncover the cause of the outbreak through layered storytelling and immersive mission design.

Limited in Demo--Multiplayer Mode: Collaborate with friends online to survive together, build communal defenses, and face tougher hordes as a team.

Character Customization: Shape your survivor’s look, stats, and abilities to reflect your gameplay preferences.

Atmospheric World-Building: Stunning visuals and a haunting soundtrack heighten the tension and deliver an unforgettable horror survival experience.

This demo is just the beginning. As Grim Hollow continues development, expect a massive expansion in gameplay, world design, and narrative depth.

Can you survive what's waiting in the dark? Or will the Hollow consume you too?

content_descriptors.notes:
Grim Hollow is an intense survival horror experience set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies and hostile factions. The game features the following mature content:

Violence and Gore: Players will engage in frequent combat against zombies and human enemies. This includes the use of melee weapons and firearms, resulting in graphic depictions of blood, dismemberment, and death. Environmental storytelling may include scenes of devastation, abandoned bodies, and remnants of past violence typical of a post-apocalyptic setting.

Horror Themes: The atmosphere is designed to evoke tension and fear, featuring dark, oppressive environments, disturbing imagery, and soundscapes that may be unsettling to some players.

Drug and Alcohol References: Some in-game environments and narrative elements may include references to substance abuse (e.g., discovering abandoned drug paraphernalia or alcohol in survival settings), consistent with the depiction of societal collapse.

Self-Harm and Mental Health Themes: The storyline may touch on themes of despair and survival under extreme conditions, including references to the psychological toll on survivors. However, Grim Hollow does not depict explicit scenes of self-harm or suicide.

Important Notes:

Grim Hollow does not contain any sexual content, nudity, or depictions of sexual assault or non-consensual acts.

There are no explicit scenes of torture or violence toward minors.
